def: to be a hand-leader, i.e. to guide (a blind person)

occurrences.text: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
